item.title: Men’s basketball: Badgers drown Huskies behind Carrington’s 32-point downpour

item.title: Eight student staff, 2,500 mouths to feed: The Open Seat Food Pantry’s campaign for help
item.description: The Open Seat food pantry, located in the UW Student Activity Center, provides food and hygiene products to students experiencing food insecurity.
